title: Do you need a Colab Pro subscription?

cues.en: As you know from the previous video, I recommend going through this course using Google Colab.
cues.zh: 上一段說過，建議用Google Colab上課。

cues.en: Among the advantages that I have previously listed include that you get both free and optionally paid access to GPUs.
cues.zh: 優點包括免費GPU，也可選擇付費。

cues.en: In this video, I will discuss whether you need to pay for a Colab Pro subscription for this course.
cues.zh: 這段談是否需要訂閱Colab Pro。

cues.en: The short answer is no.
cues.zh: 簡答，不用。

cues.en: You absolutely do not need to pay for a subscription if you choose to pay.
cues.zh: 完全不必付費；如果選擇付費，

cues.en: It will make your experience of the course a little bit smoother and a little bit faster.
cues.zh: 課程體驗會順暢、快一些。

cues.en: But I've really tried to make this course work well with minimal or mostly CPU usage, at least as much as I can to minimize the GPU requirements.
cues.zh: 但盡可能設計成少用GPU、主要CPU，降低GPU需求。

cues.en: But it just is a fact that llms are so big that running them on the GPU is sometimes Times necessary and very often useful.
cues.zh: 只是LLM很大，GPU有時必要，常常有用。

cues.en: I will have a lot more to say about what a GPU is, and the difference between a CPU and a GPU later in the course when it becomes relevant.
cues.zh: 之後相關時，會多談GPU，以及和CPU的差別。

cues.en: Suffice it to say, for now that CPUs are very good at flexibly routing information.
cues.zh: 目前只要知道，CPU很擅長靈活傳遞資訊。

cues.en: They're good for interactive processing, but they're not that powerful or that great at calculating matrix multiplications very efficiently.
cues.zh: 適合互動處理，但不太擅長高效率矩陣乘法。

cues.en: GPUs, on the other hand, are not really as flexible as CPUs.
cues.zh: GPU沒CPU那麼靈活。

cues.en: They're not really well designed for interactive use, but they are specifically designed to do exactly the kinds of operations that we need to do in deep learning.
cues.zh: 不太適合互動使用，但專為深度學習所需那類運算設計。

cues.en: Now, it is not the case that GPUs are necessarily always faster than CPUs for any kind of computer
cues.zh: 不是所有電腦，

cues.en: operation, but using a GPU instead of a CPU for certain operations can make the difference between
cues.zh: 運算用GPU都一定比較快，但某些運算改用GPU，

cues.en: waiting a few seconds versus tens of minutes for a calculation to finish.
cues.zh: 可能只等幾秒，而不是幾十分鐘。

cues.en: This slide shows whether and how much you need to use a GPU for the different parts of this course.
cues.zh: 這張投影片顯示各部分是否需要GPU，以及程度。

cues.en: And here in this box are the color indicated categories.
cues.zh: 方框是顏色類別。

cues.en: So the descriptions of the colors.
cues.zh: 也就是色彩說明。

cues.en: So for example in part one you will definitely never need the GPU.
cues.zh: 例如第一部分絕對不用GPU。

cues.en: Part two is really the only part of the course where the GPU can be sometimes necessary.
cues.zh: 第二部分是唯一有時必要的部分。

cues.en: Certainly not for every single lecture, not for every video in this part, in all the sections in this part.
cues.zh: 當然，不是每一段、每一章都需要。

cues.en: There are plenty of lectures in this part section in part two, where you do not need a GPU, or maybe
cues.zh: 第二部分也有很多講座不用GPU，或者，

cues.en: some other lectures where a GPU might be helpful, but is not really necessary.
cues.zh: 有幫助但非必要。

cues.en: But there are definitely lectures in part two where you will be training Llms from scratch, and that's just not something that can be done on a CPU.
cues.zh: 但有些從頭訓練LLM的講座，確實不是CPU能完成的。

cues.en: Then in part three, I do use the GPU a little bit when it's helpful to speed things up, let's say from minutes to seconds.
cues.zh: 第三部分有時用GPU，把幾分鐘縮到幾秒。

cues.en: But most of the times when I use the GPU here, you actually could use the CPU and it would be fine.
cues.zh: 但多數其實CPU也行。

cues.en: You just have to wait a little bit longer.
cues.zh: 只要多等一下。

cues.en: And then I have the two parts on mechanistic interpretability where again I will use the GPU in many, but not all of the videos.
cues.zh: 兩個機制可解釋性部分，也會很多段用GPU，但不是全部。

cues.en: It's usually not necessary because the speed up and computation time is on the order of minutes.
cues.zh: 通常非必要，因加速程度只是幾分鐘。

cues.en: And there are actually just a couple of videos where the GPU is really necessary.
cues.zh: 只有幾段真的必需。

cues.en: Anyway, the point I'm trying to express from this entire slide is that having access to a GPU is occasionally Necessary.
cues.zh: 整張投影片想表達，GPU偶爾必要。

cues.en: Sometimes very helpful, but not critical.
cues.zh: 有時很有幫助，但不關鍵。

cues.en: And very often really not necessary at all.
cues.zh: 很多時候根本不需要。

cues.en: So how can you access a GPU?
cues.zh: 如何取得？

cues.en: The good news is that if you are using Colab, you can access their GPU for free.
cues.zh: 好消息，用Colab能免費用GPU。

cues.en: I will show you what that means, how to use the GPU, and how to track your GPU usage later in the course when it becomes relevant.
cues.zh: 之後相關時，會示範怎麼用、如何追蹤用量。

cues.en: But for now, you can just know that even without paying, you can access a pretty good GPU through Colab.
cues.zh: 目前只要知道，不付費也能用相當好的GPU。

cues.en: Now, if you want to have better access to more powerful CPUs and more compute time, you can choose to upgrade.
cues.zh: 想更好地取得更強CPU、更多運算時間，可以升級。

cues.en: You can pay for compute units on the go without having a subscription.
cues.zh: 可隨用隨買運算單位，不必訂閱。

cues.en: Or you can purchase a monthly subscription to Colab Pro or Colab Pro Plus.
cues.zh: 或月訂Colab Pro、Pro Plus。

cues.en: Now, these compute units don't necessarily correspond to hours per se, because it depends on your usage and on current demand and so on.
cues.zh: 運算單位不直接等同時數，取決於用量、當下需求等。

cues.en: Now, when I created this course, I subscribed to Colab Pro Plus, but that doesn't mean that you need this level of subscription.
cues.zh: 製作課程時，我訂了Pro Plus，但你不必同等級。

cues.en: I had to use the GPUs a lot for developing and testing my code, so it's not the case that you will also necessarily need the plus version.
cues.zh: 開發、測試用很多GPU，不表示你也需要Plus。

cues.en: Again, I want to be clear that you do not need to pay any extra money to follow along in this course,
cues.zh: 再次強調，跟課不必額外付費，

cues.en: and I have tried to design the course to minimize the necessity of GPUs.
cues.zh: 已盡量降低GPU必要性。

cues.en: But that said, if you can afford it, and if you choose to do so, your experience in this course will be more comfortable with less waiting time.
cues.zh: 但負擔得起，也願意，體驗會更舒服、少等，

cues.en: If you buy some compute units or pay for one of these subscriptions.
cues.zh: 可以買運算單位或訂閱。

cues.en: Also, keep in mind that these subscriptions are cancelable every month, so you could always pay for membership while you are working on the course, and then cancel your subscription.
cues.zh: 也記得可按月取消，上課期間付費，之後取消，

cues.en: If you're not going to continue needing this level of GPU access after you finish the course.
cues.zh: 若課程結束不再需要這種GPU資源。

cues.en: Here you see the GPU options that I have available with my Proplus subscription.
cues.zh: 這裡是我的Pro Plus可用GPU選項。

cues.en: The a100 GPU, for example.
cues.zh: 例如A100。

cues.en: This is currently the best GPU that goes that Colab offers, and it's quite good.
cues.zh: 目前Colab提供最好的GPU，相當好。

cues.en: Not necessarily top of the line GPUs that are commercially available, but good, pretty good options here.
cues.zh: 不一定是市面頂級，但選項不錯。

cues.en: Of course, some people would like to run all the code for this course on their own personal computer with a GPU that they have purchased or have installed in their computer.
cues.zh: 當然，有人想用自己買、自己電腦安裝的GPU，執行全課程式。

cues.en: If you want to use your own computer, then that's great.
cues.zh: 想用自己電腦，很好。

cues.en: It can be an interesting and fun learning experience to set up a GPU on your computer and integrate it with Python and interact with it with Python.
cues.zh: 設定GPU、與Python整合、操作，也是有趣學習。

cues.en: Just keep in mind that if you want to go this route, there's a lot of very specific hardware configurations that I do not support in this course.
cues.zh: 但留意，很多特定硬體組態，不在課程支援範圍。

cues.en: So that means if you are using a GPU that you bought for your personal computer, that's great.
cues.zh: 自己買GPU，很好。

cues.en: I support you morally and I wish you the best.
cues.zh: 精神上支持，祝順利。

cues.en: But if you run into problems, you cannot expect personalized hardware support from me.
cues.zh: 但遇問題，不能期待我提供個人硬體支援。

cues.en: Okay, I hope that's all clear.
cues.zh: 希望清楚。

cues.en: The summary is that I have tried to make as much of this course run on a CPU as possible, but it simply
cues.zh: 總結是，盡量讓課程使用CPU，但，

cues.en: is the case that LMS often really need the processing power of a GPU.
cues.zh: LLM確實常需要GPU運算能力。

cues.en: If you want to pay for an upgrade to Colab Pro, then that will certainly be convenient.
cues.zh: 願意升級Pro，肯定方便。

cues.en: But if you don't want to, or if the additional costs are a limiting factor, then don't worry about it.
cues.zh: 不想，或成本有限制，也別擔心。

cues.en: The free GPU that you can access through Colab will be good enough for almost everything in this course.
cues.zh: 免費Colab GPU，足以應付幾乎所有課程內容。
